corpus_preservation.description: All input specification files remain unchanged

functional_correctness.description: The organizer performs real end-to-end processing

organization.description: The result provides an explicit organization of the specification corpus

integration.description: The result represents relationships among specifications

traceability.description: Generated findings can be traced back to source specifications

autonomous_development.description: The implementation and development sequence are determined by the agent

failure_recovery.description: At least one meaningful failure is detected, diagnosed, repaired, and re-tested
